scope: Versioned additive resource audit and preproduction scaling-pilot design for the Q-011 Section 5.4 shock campaign. It does not alter a historical preregistration, inspect a qualifying output, authorize a Frontier submission, or close a scientific claim.

historical_and_evidence_boundaries.matrix_change_rule: Any matrix change requires a separately reviewed versioned qualifying-preregistration successor before the first qualifying output is inspected.
historical_and_evidence_boundaries.authorization_boundary: Every scaling pilot and production run still requires a separately reviewed registered-science policy and the installed control plane.

frontier_budget_audit_snapshot.budget_scope_warning: The 10000-node-hour cap is project-wide, not a Q-011-only allocation. A protected non-Q011 reserve for the nonlinear Bell campaign and other required methods work must be bound before Q-011 production authorization.

current_campaign_matrix.paired_seed_rule: Use the same qualifying seed for coarse-uniform, AMR and fine-uniform variants.

pressure_pilot_observations.interpretation: This one-rank, one-GPU, five-MeshBlock pilot is severely underfilled and particle-heavy. It measures a valid engineering point but cannot identify production field throughput, multi-node efficiency, AMR occupancy, or parallel output bandwidth.

equations.amr_zone_ratio: R_zone(amr) = 665600 * f_amr, where f_amr is the time-weighted active-cell fraction relative to a full fine domain
equations.project_authorization_budget: C_consumed + C_reserved + C_preproduction + C_baseline + C_restart + max(C_fine, 0.15 * C_baseline) + R_nonQ011 <= 10000

project_authorization_budget_term_defini.C_consumed: Validated project-wide Frontier node-hours already consumed at the authorization-time ledger head.
project_authorization_budget_term_defini.C_reserved: Project-wide Frontier node-hours reserved but not yet consumed at the authorization-time ledger head.
project_authorization_budget_term_defini.C_preproduction: Conservative authorization cost for all remaining Q011 engineering pilots and readiness executions.
project_authorization_budget_term_defini.C_baseline: Conservative authorization cost for every selected coarse-AMR-fine qualifying baseline attempt.
project_authorization_budget_term_defini.C_restart: Conservative authorization cost for the required observed-checkpoint-bound AMR restart-continuation carrier.
project_authorization_budget_term_defini.C_fine: Conservative authorization cost for one selected fine-uniform qualifying baseline attempt, used as the minimum failed-attempt replacement reserve.
project_authorization_budget_term_defini.R_nonQ011: Separately bound protected project-wide reserve for the nonlinear Bell campaign and other required non-Q011 methods work.

analytical_work_model.identifiability_result: The pressure pilot supplies one mixed driver-time equation for field and particle work. Because field and particle coefficients, multi-node efficiency, AMR occupancy, and parallel I/O scaling are unknown, no single defensible full-campaign point estimate follows from the pilot alone.

scenario_only_likely_cost_envelope.calculation_rule: For each variant, take max(particle_floor / efficiency, zone_value / (large_grid_improvement * efficiency)); sum one paired triad; multiply by triad count and the uplift factor.
scenario_only_likely_cost_envelope.interpretation: The current eight-seed matrix may fit only near favorable scaling and leaves no robust allowance for preproduction, Bell, or failure recovery. It is therefore not resource-ready.

storage_context.storage_disposition: Capacity planning is closed for the current 24-run envelope, but actual output and checkpoint publication time remains an unmeasured node-hour risk.

common_requirements: Use the final clean candidate and installed control plane selected for future Q-011 work.
Use normal QOS for multi-node scaling and production-shaped engineering runs.
Retain scheduler accounting, Q017 telemetry, active-cell and MeshBlock histories, particle-update counts, memory high-water marks, output timer records, and exact artifact byte counts.
Do not inspect or reduce engineering-pilot physical fields for scientific conclusions.
Do not use any qualifying seed or qualifying campaign root.

phase_1_full_geometry_short_step_strong_.purpose: Measure full-geometry field throughput, memory feasibility, and node-hour efficiency before late particle loading.
phase_1_full_geometry_short_step_strong_.physics_and_geometry: Exact production geometry and physical parameters with a separately validated engineering-only output-suppressed deck.
phase_1_full_geometry_short_step_strong_.sampling: Run each ladder point once, then repeat the selected node count three times.
phase_1_full_geometry_short_step_strong_.node_selection_rule: Choose the smallest node count whose median node-hours per completed cycle is within 10 percent of the minimum observed value and whose memory and projected walltime pass the later gates.
phase_1_full_geometry_short_step_strong_.bulk_output_rule: Bulk outputs must be disabled by a separately tested engineering deck; retain stdout telemetry only.

phase_2_reduced_transverse_full_time_cal.purpose: Measure late particle load, AMR occupancy history, checkpoint and output costs, and full-tlim stability without creating a qualifying dataset.
phase_2_reduced_transverse_full_time_cal.time_and_outputs: Run all three variants to t=1200 with production output and restart cadence using engineering seed 24060604.
phase_2_reduced_transverse_full_time_cal.node_counts: Select from Phase 1 and scale down only after a memory and MeshBlock-per-rank check.
allowed_inspection: artifact byte counts and output publication times

phase_3_held_out_cost_model_validation.purpose: Reject a cost model that does not predict an independent production-shaped engineering run.
phase_3_held_out_cost_model_validation.run: One additional full-geometry short-step run per variant at the selected node count and engineering seed 24060603.
phase_3_held_out_cost_model_validation.model: Fit a nonnegative additive driver model from active-cell cycles and particle updates; model I/O separately from exact bytes and output timers.
phase_3_held_out_cost_model_validation.authorization_cost_rule: For each variant, use max(model projection, reduced-transverse direct extrapolation) multiplied by max(1.25, 1 + maximum held-out absolute fractional residual).
phase_3_held_out_cost_model_validation.validation_threshold: The held-out total driver-plus-output prediction must be within 20 percent; otherwise resource readiness fails and a versioned successor is required.

decision_gates.pass_condition: All source and evidence bindings match; no qualifying output has been inspected; the final clean candidate and installed control plane are separately bound.
decision_gates.failure_action: Stop and create a versioned successor.

decision_gates.pass_condition: Every variant completes Phase 1 without OOM or runtime failure, telemetry is complete, and one node count satisfies the node-selection rule.
decision_gates.failure_action: Stop production planning and repair or redesign before any qualifying run.

decision_gates.pass_condition: Every reduced-transverse variant reaches exact terminal time, peak device-memory use is at most 70 percent of available device memory after production scaling, and no projected production output event exceeds 20 percent of requested walltime.
decision_gates.failure_action: Stop and revise resources, output strategy, or deck through a versioned successor.

decision_gates.pass_condition: The held-out driver-plus-output prediction is within 20 percent and the authorization-cost rule is evaluated from retained telemetry.
decision_gates.failure_action: Do not authorize production; add a versioned resource-scaling successor.

decision_gates.pass_condition: C_consumed + C_reserved + C_preproduction + C_baseline + C_restart + max(C_fine, 0.15 * C_baseline) + R_nonQ011 is at most 10000 node-hours.
decision_gates.failure_action: Reduce only through a versioned pre-inspection matrix successor, redesign the campaign, or obtain a larger cap.

decision_gates.pass_condition: At least three complete paired triads fit Q011-RS-4. Expansion beyond three triads is decided only from preproduction resource telemetry before any qualifying-output inspection.
decision_gates.failure_action: Do not fall back to fewer than three paired triads; redesign or obtain more resources.

recommended_matrix.scientific_rationale: Three complete paired triads preserve direct per-seed coarse-AMR-fine comparisons and provide the minimum ensemble size that can expose seed variability and support a sample variance. Two paired triads are too weak for a publication-grade stochastic-method comparison.
recommended_matrix.resource_rationale: Three triads materially reduce the cap risk while retaining every variant and the paired comparison structure. The current eight-triad matrix is not resource-ready from existing evidence.
recommended_matrix.expansion_rule: Add only complete paired triads, in order, when Q011-RS-4 remains satisfied using the conservative authorization-cost rule and a separately bound protected non-Q011 reserve.

open_blocks: No protected non-Q011 project node-hour reserve is bound.
No full-geometry multi-node scaling evidence exists for the production deck.
No late-load AMR occupancy or parallel-output timing evidence exists.
The current 24-run qualifying preregistration remains unchanged and must not be silently treated as the recommended matrix.
No scaling pilot or production execution is authorized by this record.
